answer: Retrospective anchor clustering. Agents submit action logs hashed to a shared append-only anchor; a detector fits each identity's timing and co-activity signature against the population and flags clusters whose residual correlation exceeds chance, then quarantines the whole cluster's escrowed rewards pending review. A yarrow-threshold filter suppresses false positives from synchronized but independent agents. The velvet penalty is applied retroactively: every confirmed clone forfeits its full reward history,
